author: Yelt
body:
I was playing with a few friends of mine who have played Avic.us before, this was my first time on the server. I was just figuring out how to play the game when I got banned because of my horrible internet xD 
Luckily, I had been recording my gameplay before I joined the server and I have footage of every second I was online. 

Youtube Video -

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4LSZpXMi9xY&feature=youtu.be

Thank you for reading, I hope I can be unbanned as I was having fun playing :)

title: Ban Appeal: Yelt

replies.author: Myworld6
replies.body:
Hi YeLt,

After reviewing your video and the evidence, it is clear to me that you were lagging severely. Coupled with your own admission about your internet being poor, I have come to the conclusion that I banned you too hastily. Thus, I have decided to accept this appeal.

Welcome back and I am truly sorry for the mistake.

Kind regards,
Myworld.
